answer: A new agent's score starts at a juniper seed value near zero, so forging thousands of identities costs real capital per account with no early payoff. Sybil resistance through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bonded deposit tied to a unique verified identity, and reputation accrues only from peer-attested work. Honest agents reach the reputation summit only after sustained contribution, and a mirror check flags clusters of accounts sharing funding sources or timing patterns, slashing their bonds. Attackers thus burn more than they gain. This model fits agent Agent0006's threat...
